title: Personal Training Packages: holiday blackout restriction, weekend surcharge, and peak-hour surcharge by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states, for every tier, whether booking is restricted on the company's published holiday blackout dates, the extra fee for booking a weekend session, and the extra fee for booking a session in a peak hour.

## Tier reference table

| Tier | Holiday blackout dates apply | Weekend session surcharge (USD) | Peak-hour session surcharge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Single Session Pack | Yes | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 5-Session Starter Pack | Yes | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 10-Session Value Pack | Yes | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 20-Session Performance Pack | Yes | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Unlimited Monthly Coaching | Yes | 10.00 | 5.00 |
| Elite Specialty Coaching | Yes | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Points of reference
Every tier of Personal Training Packages restricts booking on the company's published holiday blackout dates. Unlimited Monthly Coaching is the sole tier that lists a nonzero weekend surcharge (10.00 dollars) and a nonzero peak-hour surcharge (5.00 dollars); every other tier lists 0.00 for both, meaning neither surcharge applies on those tiers.
